reviews.author: Equ222
reviews.content:
Crazy Butterflies in my Heart

Phenomenal start! I was hooked from the beginning all the way to the end. Loved the introductions for all the characters. The styling is amazing; everyone looked so good. The lighting is werkkiing especially in the club scenes. The interactions between Dean and Moth are thrilling; William and Est have such amazing chemistry together. Loved seeing the friendships between Dean and Ten & Moth and Pun. They feel genuine. Loved the setup and pacing for this  episode; the springboard for the next episode has me on the edge of my seat....

(The OST is stuck in my brain! It's so good!)

And the plot thickens! This episode leveled up the intrigue and mystery. We saw each character make interesting choices to say the least. I kept thinking “What is he doing?” and “Why would he do that?” It was an excited state of confusion. I can’t wait to learn the backstories that are motivating these characters  There’s a lot lurking under the surface. It feels very iceberg-ish, I love seeing all the different sets and filming locations. It’s a very rich, diverse, realistic universe.

I am enjoying watching Barcode and Kin. Ten makes me laugh, and I am wondering what is under Dr. Pun’s professional exterior. William and Est are giving such life to Dean and Moth. I am getting whiplash from the temperature changes.  But there are some precious moments in here…..that will live in my heart forever. i get butterflies…..crazy butterflies!

reviews.author: wetrendingteam1429
reviews.content:
**EP1 FEEDBACK/REVIEW: THE MOST BEAUIFUL EPISODE FROM GMMTV STARING IN WILLIAMEST **  
  
Watching *You Maniac* felt like stepping into something unexpectedly beautiful, because from the very first episode, I found myself completely drawn into DeanMoth’s world. I went into the series excited to see WilliamEst, but I honestly didn’t expect their chemistry to feel this natural and captivating. William’s Dean immediately caught my attention with his confident, playful, slightly chaotic personality, while Est’s Moth gave me the complete opposite energy, the quiet, mysterious, distant, and somehow impossible to look away from. What I loved most was watching Dean slowly become more interested in Moth, especially because Moth doesn’t seem impressed by all the charm Dean usually relies on, and that made every interaction between them feel so much more exciting to me. I could feel the tension in their smallest looks, pauses, and little moments, and there were so many times when I caught myself smiling at the screen without even realizing it. The visuals were also absolutely gorgeous, and I loved how different William and Est looked together—their contrasting personalities somehow made their chemistry even stronger.  
  
I keep wondering whether Dean is genuinely falling for Moth or simply becoming obsessed with the challenge of winning someone who refuses to be impressed by him, and I honestly cannot wait to find out. For me, *You Maniac* already has that addictive quality. If this is only the beginning, I already know I’m going to be emotionally invested, slightly obsessed, and probably losing my mind over these two with every episode. **For me, this truly was one of the most beautiful and memorable episodes GMMTV has given us, and WilliamEst are absolutely the reason I’m staying.**

reviews.author: floraaa_123
reviews.content:
**It’s not just a romance between two 'red flag' guys**

To be honest, I initially thought it was just going to be a typical romance about two toxic guys, but reading the novel completely changed my mind, this series is incredibly fascinating. It’s a story about two men from completely different worlds who gradually make their way into each other’s lives  
Right from the first episode, the setting, acting, and cinematography completely blew me away; it actually exceeded my expectations. On top of that, the entire cast delivers great performances, and the chemistry of Williamest goes without saying it’s absolutely phenomenal. I’ve watched all their previous works together, so I’m really looking forward to seeing how You Maniac unfolds
